t: This is the British Medical Association War Memorial, at BMA House in Tavistock Square, Bloomsbury. It commemorates men and women of the medical professions from the British Empire and Commonwealth who died in the Second World War. It was designed by the sculptor James Woodford and unveiled in 1954, and it has been Grade II* listed since 1998. Woodford also made the Queen's Beasts for the 1953 Coronation and the Robin Hood statue outside Nottingham Castle.
